user.title: Connect PlugLog
user.description: Make a key on {page} and paste it here. It's read-only: it can't change anything in PlugLog, and Home Assistant sees only the vehicles you pick there.

data_description.api_key: Starts with plk_ha_. PlugLog shows it once, when you make it.
data_description.url: Leave as it is unless you run a PlugLog test server.

reauth_confirm.title: PlugLog needs a new key
reauth_confirm.description: The key was revoked on pluglog.app, or no longer works. Make a new one on pluglog.app › Integrations › Home Assistant and paste it here.

error.invalid_key_format: That isn't a PlugLog Home Assistant key: it starts with plk_ha_. Copy it again from pluglog.app.
error.invalid_auth: PlugLog didn't accept that key. It may have been revoked: make a new one on pluglog.app.
error.not_included: Your PlugLog plan doesn't include Home Assistant. See pluglog.app › Integrations › Home Assistant.
error.cannot_connect: PlugLog couldn't be reached. Check Home Assistant's internet connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: This PlugLog account is already added.
abort.wrong_account: That key is for another PlugLog account.
